export.title: Download your data
export.description: Get one file with everything the bot holds about you, in a format a computer can read.

consents.title: Your consents
consents.description: What you agreed to. Turn one off to withdraw it. It stays listed, so you can agree again.
consents.empty: You have not given any consent yet.
consents.loadFailed: Your consents could not be loaded.

type.tos_privacy: Terms of service and privacy policy

requests.title: Your requests
requests.description: Every export, erasure and opt-out you asked for, newest first.
requests.empty: You have not made a request yet.
requests.loadFailed: Your requests could not be loaded.

optOut.title: Opt out of extra processing
optOut.description: Stops marketing, leaderboards and analytics use of your data. Your data stays.

erase.title: Erase your data
erase.rowDescription: Destroys your personal data and ends your sign-in. The bot counts what it would destroy before it asks you.
erase.confirmDescription: This cannot be undone. The bot destroys the data below and signs you out.
erase.nothing: The bot holds nothing to destroy.
erase.requested: Your erasure is requested. It shows under your requests.
